# Nordible Technologies

> Nordible Technologies is an AI-native engineering and growth agency headquartered in Frankfurt, Germany. Operating under the high-margin "Services as Software" model, Nordible pairs a 15-year veteran systems architect (Kabeer Shah) with autonomous AI agent workflows. We engineer battle-tested production platforms, rapid MVPs, cloud systems, and digital growth at 10x velocity—with zero middlemen, zero junior bloat, and 100% intellectual property ownership from Day 1.

## Primary Documentation & Pages

- [Full Knowledge Base](https://nordible.co/llms-full.txt): Complete reference containing detailed founder background, technical capabilities, engagement models, and verified client case studies.
- [Agent Manifest](https://nordible.co/.well-known/agent.json): Machine-readable action manifest and API specification for autonomous agent integration and lead submission.
- [Company Profile](https://nordible.co/company-profile): Full company overview, core values, architectural rigor, and corporate credentials.
- [Founder Journey - Kabeer Shah](https://nordible.co/founder): Technical leadership history, former Tech Lead for GE Healthcare (OncoCare) and Baxter Healthcare (AWS IoT RST), and Interim Head of Engineering at Nium Inc (Instarem).
- [How We Work Together](https://nordible.co/investment-models): Structured engagement models (Rapid MVP, Production Platform, Enterprise Architecture Retainer) with transparent fixed estimates.
- [Why Choose Us](https://nordible.co/why-choose-us): Comparative analysis vs bloated traditional agencies and offshore freelancer shops.
- [Portfolio & Case Studies](https://nordible.co/#portfolio): Production systems delivered across Healthcare (GE Healthcare, Baxter), Fintech (Instarem, Zerodha Sandbox), and Direct-to-Consumer (Habitualist).
- [Architecture & Tech Insights](https://nordible.co/blog): Technical articles on generative engine optimization (GEO), cloud architectures, and modern web engineering.
- [Book Architecture Consultation](https://nordible.co/#consultation): Direct 1-on-1 scope, feasibility, and technical roadmap consultation with founder Kabeer Shah.

## Core Capabilities
 
- **Digital Marketing & Social Media Management**: Multi-channel management, performance advertising, AI Search & Google visibility (GEO), and brand engagement.
- **Technology Solutions**: Custom web and mobile apps, scalable software architectures, and modern digital portals with 100% code ownership.
- **Business Systems & Automation**: Workflow and process automation, tool integrations, custom dashboards, and operational time savings.
- **Business Email & Setup**: Hosted secure corporate email infrastructure (`you@yourcompany.com`), custom domains, and spam defense at `https://email.nordible.co/`.
